title: Exported strings deleted by Undo
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in 4.5.0 and 4.5.1



### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

Hi, asked on the discord and was advised that this could be a bug. I ended up losing a bit of work to it earlier:

When clicking into an export field in the inspector tab (or the export_multiline's full text editor), Undo'ing (either through context menu or Ctrl+Z) beyond the point that any changes have been made results in the entire field's contents being deleted-- even if they were already saved or a default value. 
Initially, the content can be recovered via Redo, but if you navigate away from the node or close it in a panic (as I did), the content is lost enduringly. 

I would instead expect Undo to have no effect before any changes have been made. 

In case it is helpful, Ste on the discord had this to say: 
> i assume why that's happening is because opening the editor sets the text to the given value, which is a `do` action, for which the `undo` is removing it all

### Steps to reproduce

- Open the provided MRP
- Click either of the export fields
- Press Ctrl+Z, or select Undo from the right click context menu
- The saved text disappears
- At this point, the deletion can be Redone,
- But clicking onto any other node means the content is fully lost; Redo will be greyed out when returning.
